title: Rate Lock Commitment Float-Down Fee
content:
On a **Rate Lock Commitment** float-down, the improvement, the fee points and the fee are defined as follows.

- **Improvement.** The improvement is the lock's locked rate less the rate on its latest float-down request in the lock request log, to three decimal places.
- **Fee points.** The float-down fee points are the lock's float-down fee points, as set for its product, to three decimal places.
- **Fee.** The float-down fee is the float-down fee points times the loan amount at lock divided by 100, rounded to the cent.

### Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Product | Locked rate | Rate on the latest float-down request | Improvement | Float-down fee points | Loan amount at lock | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 7.000% | 6.750% | 0.250 | 0.250 | $400,000.00 | $1,000.00 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 6.875% | 6.625% | 0.250 | 0.375 | $310,000.00 | $1,162.50 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 7.125% | 6.875% | 0.250 | 0.500 | $455,500.00 | $2,277.50 |
